concept: A handcrafted dark-fantasy traveler follows a living brass compass through a storm-soaked miniature city.

style_bible.materials: felt, carved wood, oxidized brass, wet stone
style_bible.lighting: warm practicals against cool storm ambience

character_bible.wardrobe: mustard raincoat, dark boots, red scarf

shots.description: Rain falls across the miniature city as the traveler enters frame.
The traveler opens a weathered brass compass beneath a street lamp.
The compass needle spins and points toward a narrow alley.
The traveler follows the glowing compass into the alley.
A puddle reflection reveals a shadow moving behind the traveler.
The traveler stops; the compass light intensifies in both hands.
A tiny wooden door emerges from the wet brick wall.
The traveler unlocks the impossible door with the compass.
Warm impossible light floods the alley as the traveler steps through.
